name: Shambhala School

geo.coord_source: Nova Scotia private-schools dataset georeference POINT (-63.59668 44.66184)

description: Halifax private school (Primary–Grade 12) recognized by Nova Scotia to grant the High School Leaving Certificate. Its name refers to the Shambhala Buddhist community; whether the programme is a distinct contemplative alternative could not be verified because the website refused access.

legal_status.label: Recognized private school granting the Nova Scotia High School Leaving Certificate
legal_status.authority: Nova Scotia Department of Education and Early Childhood Development

limitations: Recognition renewal date in the dataset is 31 July 2026 (already passed) although the row is still listed
attributes.qualifying_reason: Provincially recognized private school, but the official site could not be read (HTTP 401 on two attempts) and SPEC §7 admits a religious-affiliated school only for an independently qualifying model, which is unverified.
